policy: Descriptive current-vintage associations between changes, not price levels. Match exact start and end observation dates; no forward filling or bridging gaps over four days. Futures use completed daily candles; other series use available cached observations. Different market closing times, delayed publication, contract rolls, missing observations and revisions limit comparability. Correlation shift compares disjoint 60-observation windows; divergence is an out-of-sample residual relative to prior 60 paired observations (second series regressed on first). Thresholds are monitoring choices, not significance tests; no causal, directional or trading edge claims.
